clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Sentinel Selarin seeks help for Ashenvale's defenders. She carries Raene Wolfrunner's appeal to the coastal settlement as dangers threaten the forest.

Sentinel Selarin carries Raene Wolfrunner's appeal from Ashenvale to Auberdine. With threats mounting across Ashenvale, the garrison is stretched thin. Selarin travels north along the forest road into Darkshore to find Terenthis and ask for help from the sentinels and scouts stationed on the coast.

Terenthis cannot answer Selarin's appeal in person, so she remains in Auberdine to enlist travelers passing through Darkshore. She sends capable adventurers south to Astranaar, where they can bring their blades and spells to Raene Wolfrunner's beleaguered forces.
